blocks.text: Beauty queen and actress Roxie Smith has announced her engagement to her longtime, non-showbiz boyfriend, Karl Adolfo. Smith shared photos from the beachside proposal on Instagram, showing Adolfo getting down on one knee as she accepted his marriage proposal. The proposal took place in Mactan, Cebu, with some of Smith’s celebrity friends, including Ashley Ortega and Sugar Mercado, among those present for the occasion. “The ocean, the people I love, and the person I’ll spend the rest of my life loving.
